settings.label: How We Work
settings.sub: Design, development and construction, one team, all in-house.

settings.text: Good developments happen when the people who design a home are the same people who build it. At Sabdia they are. Every discipline is in-house, one team, one standard.
The same people make every decision, on the first sketch and on handover day. Nothing is handed off and nothing gets lost.

settings.label: Design
settings.title: Luxury Residential Design
settings.paragraphs:
Our architecture and design team is in-house. Each home starts with the site, the street and the client, before anything is drawn.
The result is a home that belongs to its site and its owners.
settings.bullets:
Architectural concept and schematic design
Design development and documentation
Planning approvals and DA management
Landscape architecture
Material and finishes specification
3D visualisation and virtual walkthroughs

settings.label: Development
settings.title: Development Management
settings.paragraphs:
Development management is everything between the land and the keys: town planning, engineering, approvals, finance, sales and delivery.
We do all of it in-house. Fewer hand-offs means fewer delays and a tighter budget.
settings.bullets:
Site acquisition analysis and due diligence
Feasibility modelling and investment structuring
Town planning strategy and DA management
Engineering and civil coordination
Sales and marketing strategy
Project reporting and stakeholder management

settings.label: Interiors
settings.title: Interior Architecture
settings.paragraphs:
Our interior architects work with the architecture team from day one, so the inside of the house is planned with the same care as the outside.
Kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms and living rooms are designed together, so light, materials and proportion carry through the whole house.
settings.bullets:
Interior concept and spatial design
Custom joinery design and specification
Material, finish, and hardware selection
Lighting design and coordination
FF&E procurement and styling
Kitchen and bathroom design

settings.label: Construction
settings.title: Expert Construction
settings.paragraphs:
Our own team builds every home. Many of the trades have worked with Sabdia for years and hold the same standard we do.
Good materials from suppliers we trust, and no shortcuts. The house should look right at handover and still be right in twenty years.
settings.bullets:
Full residential construction management
Premium material sourcing and procurement
Master tradesperson coordination
Quality assurance and defect management
Client reporting and site access
Post-completion aftercare and warranty

settings.title: Design
settings.description: Design that works as well as it looks. We start with the site, the street and the people.

settings.title: Develop
settings.description: Approvals, planning and engineering are handled in-house, so every decision is ours.

settings.title: Construct
settings.description: Our own team builds it, with the materials we specified and a check at every stage.

settings.title: Deliver
settings.description: After handover we stay in touch. If something needs attention, we come back.
